notes.title: Conflict of Lords - Demo Available Now!
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

Conflict of Lords is an Roguelite Anti-TD game. You will act as the Lord of Foe in Game Development Council, who decided to go his separate way due to a conflict. Invade the newly released game Village Guardian. Summon the Predators to destroy villages. Destroy the heroes manipulated by "players".

The game is still in the early stages of development and will require a considerable amount of time for further development. If you have any problems / BUG report/ gameplay suggestions, please feel free to leave them on Steam Community.

The English localization is in progress, please stay tuned!
